snippet.title: Collect Call | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3832430/Collect_Call
Music is Rituals by Shared Systems: https://soundcloud.com/dannyjudas/sets/collect-call-2025

Hoard plastic, spill blood. Inhabit the mind of an android and ply your steel to shred flesh and snap wires. Evolve, adapt, and scalpel away your limitations in this cyberpunk deckbuilder.
